title: a-phase-write-records-at-the-tickets-own-address
author: CC

watchme.trigger: on each ground-loop beat, against the ticket corpus and the door's own record
watchme.enough: at least 3 phase_writes records exist across at least 2 DISTINCT calendar days that are not the initial backlog batch's day, AND every ticket in the corpus whose cursor carries a written phase (waiting, queued, hold) has a phase_writes entry whose workflow field matches its current workflow_and_state string. Both halves are required: the first says the door is still being used, the second says no hand-edit slipped past it. Sustained one week after the batch.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier — specifically the WRONG INTENT branch, that the door lands and hand-edits continue anyway
watchme.consumer: Akien, via the operator inbox; a red here is the same finding pickup() earned in August 2026 and is worth the same escalation

gates_bound.how: proofs beside cairn/tools/base, run twice and sealed under the tester; teeth a hollow build could not pass — the round-trip proof mutates a real ticket copy and diffs it byte-for-byte, and the refusal proofs assert nothing was written

the claiming validate berth's criteria run by their instruments and the verdict written through verdict.write_verdict before the PROVED crossing; a failed criterion is a kick-back to the chart, never a crossing
inspect_entry's three sieves — a berthed chart chain claiming this ticket, intent_berth present, sorted_berth present — all three refused together on the first pass
the emission gate reads the crossing's ticket, finds the spec for the named object and refuses an unarmed probe (WatchmeEmissionRed)

children: none, because the seam is one door in one module with one repair beside it. The 34 backlog phase writes are this door's first CALLER, not children of it — they are the occasion that made the gap visible and they belong to the queue-sorting work, which is a separate act with its own record. Splitting the door from the repair of 6bc43453ca64 would leave a known-wrong record standing while its fix waits in a second voyage, which is the drift Law 9 reds.
intention: A phase write is recorded at the ticket's own address: set_phase appends to that ticket's own phase record and updates its workflow_and_state in one act.
